name: Declared Summary-Route Planning (summaries-plan)
description: C11/C06 planning demo: the `summaries-plan` route drives real C11 probes against the declared summary adapters and emits a mumei.summaries-plan/v1 plan — selecting agent.go-summaries only when a tool-version pin is declared, recording bounded adapter-probe-history records, and resuming a persisted history so a second pass continues the attempt count.

intent_fidelity.source_intent: Show the declared summaries-plan route probing real adapter commands, selecting the Go summary adapter only under a declared tool-version pin, and resuming a persisted probe history across passes.
success_criteria: plan.json carries schema mumei.summaries-plan/v1 with plan.selected.adapter_id agent.go-summaries and a probe history record (mumei.adapter-probe-history/v1)
resumed.json shows the Go adapter history continuing attempt_number 1 -> 2 from the persisted histories
unpinned.json carries plan.selected null and the Go decision reason tool_version_unknown — no declared pin, no selection

harness_contract.intent: Demonstrate the C11 probe-driven planning boundary end to end: `python -m agent summaries-plan` runs each declared adapter's probe_argv through AttemptRunner, reports availability as observed command behavior, selects the Go adapter only when its declared tool-version pin is satisfied, and resumes a persisted mumei.adapter-probe-history/v1 record so the second pass continues attempt numbers rather than restarting them.
artifact_contracts: Step 1 runs summaries-plan with a declared --tool-version and asserts plan.selected.adapter_id == agent.go-summaries, a selected_priority decision reason, an available observation and one adapter-probe-history record, then saves histories.json.
Step 2 reruns with --histories histories.json and asserts the Go adapter's outcomes list continues attempt_number 1 -> 2 instead of restarting at 1.
Step 3 reruns without --tool-version and asserts plan.selected is null with the Go decision reason tool_version_unknown — the planner refuses to select on an undeclared pin.
Generate evidence: plan1.log, plan2.log, plan3.log, plan.json, resumed.json, unpinned.json, histories.json, harness_state.json, result.json, and report.md.
notes: Each adapter's probe_argv is `python -m agent <route> --help` — probes observe real command behavior on the agent checkout, so availability is deterministic wherever the agent runs; no external toolchain is required.
Availability is an observed outcome, not a health claim: the route only selects the profile-supporting adapter, and only when the declared tool-version pin is satisfied.
The --histories input is a persisted mumei.adapter-probe-history/v1 array; a resumed retry records base stamp plus the previous attempt count.
Every step exits the rc-preserving form so a failed command cannot pass silently as exit-0 output.
budget_policy_fingerprint is summaries-plan-v1 for deterministic runs.

steps.name: Declared tool-version pin selects the Go summary adapter
steps.command: {mumei_agent_python} -m agent summaries-plan --profile mumei.go-scalar-parameter-deps/v1 --stamp 1 --tool-version 1.23.0 > {output_dir}/plan.json 2> {output_dir}/plan1.err; rc=$?; cat {output_dir}/plan.json; cat {output_dir}/plan1.err; test $rc -eq 0 && python3 -c "import json; d=json.load(open('{output_dir}/plan.json')); assert d['schema_version']=='mumei.summaries-plan/v1', d['schema_version']; assert d['profile']=='mumei.go-scalar-parameter-deps/v1'; sel=d['plan']['selected']; assert sel and sel['adapter_id']=='agent.go-summaries', sel; assert sel['observed_tool_version']=='1.23.0'; go=[x for x in d['plan']['decisions'] if x['adapter_id']=='agent.go-summaries']; assert go and go[0]['reasons']==['selected_priority'], go; obs=[o for o in d['observations'] if o['adapter_id']=='agent.go-summaries']; assert obs and obs[0]['availability']=='available' and obs[0]['tool_version']=='1.23.0', obs; hist=[h for h in d['histories'] if h['adapter_id']=='agent.go-summaries']; assert hist and hist[0]['schema_version']=='mumei.adapter-probe-history/v1' and len(hist[0]['outcomes'])==1, hist; json.dump(d['histories'], open('{output_dir}/histories.json','w')); print('summaries-plan: go adapter selected under declared pin')"
steps.artifact_contract: plan.json holds mumei.summaries-plan/v1 whose plan selects agent.go-summaries with observed_tool_version 1.23.0; histories.json persists the emitted adapter-probe-history array.
steps.verifier_gate: summaries-plan exits 0; the Go adapter is selected with reason selected_priority and one probe outcome is recorded.

steps.name: Persisted probe history resumes the attempt count
steps.command: {mumei_agent_python} -m agent summaries-plan --profile mumei.go-scalar-parameter-deps/v1 --stamp 1 --tool-version 1.23.0 --histories {output_dir}/histories.json > {output_dir}/resumed.json 2> {output_dir}/plan2.err; rc=$?; cat {output_dir}/resumed.json; cat {output_dir}/plan2.err; test $rc -eq 0 && python3 -c "import json; d=json.load(open('{output_dir}/resumed.json')); assert d['schema_version']=='mumei.summaries-plan/v1'; hist=[h for h in d['histories'] if h['adapter_id']=='agent.go-summaries']; assert hist and [o['attempt_number'] for o in hist[0]['outcomes']]==[1,2], hist; sel=d['plan']['selected']; assert sel and sel['adapter_id']=='agent.go-summaries'; print('summaries-plan: resumed history continues attempt 1 -> 2')"
steps.artifact_contract: resumed.json holds mumei.summaries-plan/v1 whose Go adapter history carries outcomes with attempt_number [1, 2].
steps.verifier_gate: summaries-plan exits 0; the persisted mumei.adapter-probe-history/v1 record resumes instead of restarting.

steps.name: No declared tool-version pin selects nothing
steps.command: {mumei_agent_python} -m agent summaries-plan --profile mumei.go-scalar-parameter-deps/v1 --stamp 1 > {output_dir}/unpinned.json 2> {output_dir}/plan3.err; rc=$?; cat {output_dir}/unpinned.json; cat {output_dir}/plan3.err; test $rc -eq 0 && python3 -c "import json; d=json.load(open('{output_dir}/unpinned.json')); assert d['schema_version']=='mumei.summaries-plan/v1'; assert d['plan']['selected'] is None, d['plan']['selected']; go=[x for x in d['plan']['decisions'] if x['adapter_id']=='agent.go-summaries']; assert go and 'tool_version_unknown' in go[0]['reasons'], go; print('summaries-plan: undeclared pin selects nothing')"
steps.artifact_contract: unpinned.json holds mumei.summaries-plan/v1 with plan.selected null and the Go decision reason tool_version_unknown.
steps.verifier_gate: summaries-plan exits 0 with no selection; a missing declared pin is a planning decision, not an error.

intro: Step 1: summaries-plan probes each declared adapter and selects the Go adapter under a declared tool-version pin...
Step 2: rerunning with the persisted probe history resumes its attempt count (1 -> 2)...
Step 3: rerunning without a declared pin selects nothing — planning stays honest...
narrative.before: Adapter availability was an unassessed declaration: the planner had no observed evidence of which summary route could serve a profile.
narrative.after: summaries-plan records bounded mumei.adapter-probe-history/v1 observations and selects only the profile-supporting adapter whose declared tool-version pin is satisfied.

pass.headline: Go summary adapter selected under the declared pin
follow_up: Step 2: Rerunning with the persisted history...

pass.headline: Persisted probe history resumes attempt 1 -> 2
follow_up: The adapter-probe-history record continues instead of restarting.

pass.headline: No declared pin — no selection

Demo complete: the probe-driven planning boundary is observable end to end.

resumed.json continues the Go adapter attempt count 1 -> 2 from the persisted histories
unpinned.json carries plan.selected null with reason tool_version_unknown
